name: Vyapar Books PRO
releaseNotes: New: invoice, party and item lists above 100 rows now load in windows of 60 with a Show more button
New: audit-log retention policy, storage-quota banner and startup data-integrity report
Improved: payment conflicts are strictly manual per document; bulk merge removed
Improved: invoice preview, POS catalog and voucher allocation split into focused components
Improved: tabs no longer re-render when an unrelated collection changes
Fixed: durable retry queue for failed cloud writes, so saves survive temporary failures
